conventions.graph: htk.graph.theta(p,q,r): N = 0, N' = root = p+q+r-2, interior vertices along A, B, C; edge order A, B, C; edges N -> N'
conventions.names: N, Np = trivalent vertices (Np = root), Pk = k-th interior vertex of path P from N; [v1..vH] = det of the H x H matrix with columns lam_v1..lam_vH
conventions.K_htk: reduced kernel of P/code/htk/CONVENTIONS.md (positively oriented cycle basis)
conventions.C3: cycle matrix (A-B, B-C); K[C3] = sign_C3_basis * c * (...); K_htk = (-1)^{(q+1)D} K[C3]
conventions.root_at_interior_vertex: K as a function of the full source vector (sum zero) is the same for C3; substitute lam_root = -sum_{v != root} lam_v; htk sign: K_htk[G relabelled by the transposition rho <-> N'] = (-1)^D K_htk[G]
